title: Battle of Villinghausen
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Villinghausen", at revision 1379579453, opens: "The Battle of Villinghausen, took place during the Seven Years' War fought on the 15th and 16 July 1761 in the western area of present-day Germany, between a large French army and an Anglo-German force led by Prince Ferdinand of Brunswick. The French commanders failed to coordinate their actions and suffered defeat." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q689007, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1761 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
